visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-definition close-up shot focuses on the reflective Mercedes-Benz emblem on the hood of a light grey SUV. She walks confidently towards the front of the silver car parked on a suburban street lined with lush green trees. She smiles and gestures towards the vehicle. (2) Transitioning to the car interior, the woman sits in the driver's seat, holding a white paper titled with exam-style text. The lighting is bright and even. She laughs and talks to the camera, showcasing her expressive facial features and animated hand movements. The interior features high-quality materials and circular air vents. (3) The video displays a montage of the car's exterior features. Close-ups show the intricate star-patterned grille, sleek LED headlights, and the AMG Line badging. The car is seen driving on a road surrounded by dense foliage. In subsequent interior shots, a hand interacts with a large digital touchscreen, adjusting the 64-color ambient lighting which pulses with vibrant blue and purple hues across the dashboard and vents. (4) Heavy raindrops are visible on the panoramic glass sunroof as the woman drives through a grey, overcast environment. She looks up with a satisfied expression. The camera cuts between her face, the digital instrument cluster, and the AR navigation display on the infotainment screen, which overlays blue arrows on the live road feed. (5) The car is shown driving through deep puddles on a wet road, creating large white splashes that partially obscure the vehicle. Finally, the woman is seen outside the car in front of a white building displaying the Mercedes-Benz logo. She waves goodbye to the camera. The setting is a bright, clear day in this final scene, suggesting a transition in time or location.
